//: Do2Date is a static site plus one serverless function. There is no build
step and no framework — the HTML, CSS and JS in the repo root are served
as-is, exactly as GitHub Pages served them, so nothing about how the site
looks or behaves changes with the move. What Vercel adds is api/, which is
where GEMINI_API_KEY can live without shipping to the browser.
Required environment variables (Project Settings -> Environment Variables):
The old service worker cached index.html indefinitely, which is why
shipping a change meant bumping ?v=NN by hand and hoping. Telling the
browser not to store the HTML shell means a deploy actually reaches
people. The hashed-forever pattern does not apply here: these files
have stable names, so they must revalidate.
